scope: Completed source audit of 55 current editor option groups, plus actual schema parsing/conversion probes and native renderer availability checks.

comparison.notes: Native Crop is contain plus 1.33x scaling. It retains letterboxing; Fill uses cover. Poster and video transforms verified in the browser.

missing: Library film search beyond the four seeds
blocks.implementation: Standalone converter fixes autoplay=true and muted=false; preview deliberately overrides autoplay=false. Backgrounds are fixed muted/autoplay. Library resolver fixes English language 529. Autoplay and mute toggle gaps concern standalone videos; native backgrounds always autoplay, mute and loop.
blocks.priority: Autoplay, mute and custom cover first. Broader library search requires a discovery tool/resolver, not only an enum. Languages, uploads and subtitle catalogues require accompanying workflows.

blocks.implementation: imageForModel retains only search and alt. Converter fixes focal point at 50/50 and scale=null.
blocks.priority: Focal point and scale first, for requests such as keep the face visible. Asset IDs should be resolved by a media tool.

blocks.namingMismatch: AI title maps to h1, which the editor labels Display. AI body maps to body1, which the editor labels Large Body. Editor Title is h2; Normal Body is body2. Several heading sizes are unavailable through the AI aliases. AI subtitle maps to subtitle1, which is not offered in the current editor size selector.
blocks.priority: Align style vocabulary with the editor and add text color. This can reduce oversized titles/body text on cards. Font themes are journey-wide rather than per-block fields.

blocks.implementation: Both primary and secondary AI styles use buttonColor=primary. Secondary only means outlined; it does not select secondary color. Size is fixed large. settings=null and endIconId=null. The schema has 21 icons, including 2 deprecated options; 7 of the editor's 26 current choices are absent.
blocks.priority: Expose size, alignment, actual variant/color and trailing icon separately. Keep submit behavior semantic and automatic.
Image polls are a meaningful missing capability, distinct from adding an unrelated image block above the poll.

missing: Minimum-selection upper-bound validation when max is omitted
blocks.implementation: All main settings are exposed, but min alone can exceed option count. The editor clamps this case.
blocks.priority: Add min <= option count validation, including when max is absent.
Phone, hint and row count are useful additions. Integration configuration is a separate account-backed workflow.
Low. Avoid encouraging large spacers after the footer-overlap problem.

blocks.implementation: Color accepts six hex digits only, backdropBlur=null, showAssistant=false and expandChatByDefault=false. Native background-video layout remains contained, matching the editor restriction. Explicit inherited/default style is not represented; omitted theme deliberately resolves dark.
blocks.priority: Opacity and blur are useful visual controls. Chat requires assistant/runtime support beyond draft JSON.

crossCutting.actions: Step and website actions exist in AI; email, chat, phone/SMS and no-action are omitted.
crossCutting.templates: Customization placeholders, customizable media/actions, adapter notes and global font themes are outside the current draft schema.
crossCutting.legacy: SignUp exists in the shared renderer but is absent from the current Add a block menu and explicitly unsupported by the AI. VideoTrigger exists in data/rendering but is not currently authorable as a normal editor block; do not count these as ordinary missing menu options.

recommendedNextBatch: Fix the multiselect minimum-count validation gap
Text style vocabulary parity and color
Phone input, hint, rows and hide-label
verificationPolicy: For each addition, verify schema acceptance and retention, conversion to native block fields, and visible browser behavior. Keep IDs, stream URLs and available assets resolved by trusted tools. A field appearing in JSON alone does not establish support.

verification.method: Read current Properties dispatch, all block property controls and native renderer fields; ran actual schema parsing, block conversion and semantic checks with 41 option probes plus five multiselect limit cases.
verification.newFinding: Multiselect with two options and min=3, max omitted passes current AI validation; current editor clamps minimum to the option count.

nativeConstraints.backgroundVideo: Native renderer always autoplays, mutes and loops; these are not editable standalone-style toggles for backgrounds.
nativeConstraints.videoFit: YouTube and website mode force Fit. Editor disables the choice for those contexts.
nativeConstraints.cardDefault: Editor supports Default/inherited in addition to Light/Dark; AI resolves omitted theme to Dark.
nativeConstraints.filterOpacity: Alpha/opacity editing is available for eligible expanded image layouts, not contained covers.
nativeConstraints.youTubeBackground: YouTube fit controls are disabled in the editor. The native background renderer additionally scales its wrapper by viewport; objectFit alone does not promise an uncropped YouTube background.

namingDetails: AI title maps to editor Display, not editor Title.
AI body maps to editor Large Body, not Normal Body.
AI subtitle maps to subtitle1, which is not a size offered in the current text variant selector.
AI button primary/secondary select contained/outlined appearance; both use primary color.
findingsRequiringFix: Multiselect minimum can exceed option count when maximum is omitted.
AI icon list includes deprecated LiveTvRounded and LockOpenRounded and omits seven non-deprecated editor choices.
Text style and button style aliases do not match editor labels.
